name: get_rolling_release_config
description:
Get the Rolling Releases configuration for a project. The project-level config is simply a template that will be used for any future rolling release, and not the configuration for any active rolling release.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/projects/{idOrName}/rolling-release/config --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.
